# 3d-paper-tile

<!-- Generated by `iig3d.py docs` from catalogue/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Member of the 3D corporate family. Embossed paper tiles, hexagons, tabs and tile-capped charts. Backdrop: Blue-grey studio. Items: 6 to 16. Default aspect: landscape.

## Colour palette

- Family item colours on tile faces, rims and chart fills
- Blue-grey studio backdrop #C9D3DC to #E6ECF1, which makes white tiles read as raised paper
- White or very light grey face plates; the colour lives in the rim, the tab or the fill

## Visual elements

- Tiles have a 2 to 3 percent raised edge and a soft shadow, as if cut from thick card
- Square tiles carry a big numeral over STEP; hexagons carry a numeral or icon
- Charts: bars are flat colour columns capped with a white percentage tile; pies and rings have wedges that step forward
- Tabs: long rounded rectangles with a coloured numeral panel on the left and a white text panel on the right
- Segment wheel: 4 to 8 wedges around a central disc, each wedge with an icon and a two-line label
- Thin coloured connectors and leader lines with dot terminals

## Typography

- Family typography; numerals white on coloured tiles, names bold caps beside or under the tile
- Percentages bold in the item colour on white caps

## Composition rules

- Grid layouts: 2 by 2 up to 4 by 4 tiles with equal gutters, one accent element in the centre cell when the count is odd
- Dashboard: two to four chart modules on separate tile panels, each with its own headline number
- Hexagon tree: parent at top, children in one row, terminals below with text
- Keep modules aligned to a visible column grid; whitespace between modules is part of the style

## Layout

### Structure

- Raised white card tiles aligned to a visible column grid
- Colour lives in the rim, tab or fill, not the tile face
- Badge or numeral panel set into a tile corner
- Tabs: long rectangles with a coloured numeral panel left and a white text panel right
- Modules separated by equal gutters

### Variants

| Variant | Focus | Visual emphasis |
|---------|-------|-----------------|
| **Square tile grid** | Collections, ledgers, issue lists | 2 by 2 up to 4 by 4 tiles |
| **Tab panels** | Plans, matrices with gates | Column panels of stacked numbered tabs |
| **Hexagon tree** | Shallow hierarchies | Parent at top, children in a row |
| **Segment wheel** | Cycles | 4 to 8 wedges around a central disc |
| **Tile-capped charts** | Dashboards, KPIs | Bars capped with white percentage tiles |

### Visual elements

- Tiles with a 2 to 3 percent raised edge and soft offset shadow
- Studio ground slightly darker than the tiles so they read as raised card
- Big numeral on each square tile
- Thin coloured rims and connectors with dot terminals
- Small tabs on tile edges for footnotes or sources

### Text placement

- Title at top
- Tile heading bold on or beside the tile, body inside the tile
- Column headers on a coloured panel across the top of each tile panel
- Legend bottom right
- Whitespace between modules kept as part of the layout

## Best for

- KPI dashboards and scorecards
- Modular overviews and categorised collections
- Option menus and matrices
- Hierarchies with few levels
